stem: The decision in Marbury v. Madison was significant in U.S. history because it —

options.label: F
options.text: reinforced federal authority over American Indian affairs

options.label: G
options.text: confirmed the power of Congress to regulate interstate commerce

options.label: H
options.text: established the practice of judicial review by the Supreme Court

options.label: J
